text:
mira: Quick RFC — proposal to replace the verbose per-field routing/telemetry headers with a compact aggregated header to cut ingress size and simplify ingestion. thinking name `X-RW-CM` (compact-metrics). e.g. `X-RW-CM: v1|r=web-chat|q=42|p=0.8` :eyes:

aj: Short question — will old SDKs blow up if they see the new header shape? timeline?

sam: @mira we parse headers in all three SDKs (py/ts/go). any change to shape without a shim will cause parsing errors. we should definitely avoid a hard break.

rachel: From console/product POV we need a stable metric key mapping. dashboards depend on the current expanded fields. if we change names/shape the dashboards will show gaps. need a migration mapping plan.

tom: We can add a proxy shim in the gateway to emit both: old verbose headers + new `X-RW-CM` for a transition window. downside: extra CPU and string ops per request. sampling may help.

ci-bot: github PR linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842 — gateway shim prototype (benchmarks attached).

leo: Suggest opt-in feature-flag per tenant so we can flip customers progressively. also add header `X-RW-CM-V` for version negotiation.

nina: For SDKs: implement tolerant parsers — try compact first, fall back to verbose, and log a single WARN event. ship in a minor version.

aj: That fallback approach sounds safe. we should also add a compatibility test in the e2e suite that exercises both headers.

sam: Plan proposal: 1) deploy proxy shim default-on (emit both) + sampling for CPU for 4 weeks. 2) ship SDK tolerant parsers (py/ts/go) in v0.XX (minor) and announce opt-in. 3) console mapping update to accept compact fields and translate to old metric keys. 4) after 3 months, flip ff to require compact and remove shim.

mira: + owners: infra/gateway (tom), sdks (sam), console (rachel), rollout/comms (aj). I'll draft the rollout checklist.

tom: we'll include light-weight sampling (1% by default) to mitigate CPU while telemetry team ramps. will post perf numbers in the next 24h.

rachel: Product will prepare a console banner + changelog note and a migration doc for customers. runway: need at least 2 weeks notice before SDK minor release.

sam: I'll start PRs for py/ts/go tolerant parsing today and add tests. calling out edgecases: corrupted compact header should not throw.

aj: One more ask — add a telemetry event when a request used fallback parsing so we can measure adoption.

mira: Agreed. Add metric `telemetry.header_parser.fallback_count` and expose it in console tile.

leo: If anyone's blocked, ping me. otherwise looks like consensus. :thumbsup:

mira: OK, I'll spin up the checklist and post an official rollout plan tomorrow. thanks all.
